# 3d-gradient-pedestal

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Isometric gradient pedestals with floating 3D numerals. Backdrop: Pale studio, gradient fade. Items: 3 to 5. Default aspect: landscape.

## Reference images

| Ref | Shows | Flags |
|-----|-------|-------|
| `ref-01-four-pedestals.jpg` | Four isometric pedestals in lime, teal, blue and purple gradients fading upward, white extruded numerals 1 to 4 lying on the tops, icon and text in the fade above | clean |

## Colour palette

- One family colour per pedestal, rendered as a vertical gradient from saturated at the base to transparent at about 60 percent height
- Pale studio backdrop #F4F6F9, near white, no map or grid
- Numerals pure white with a soft grey side face

## Visual elements

- Pedestal base is an isometric slab 8 to 10 percent thick; the column above is a translucent glass gradient
- White 3D numeral lies flat on the pedestal top, slightly rotated to match the isometric angle
- Icon in the item colour at the top of the fade, step name below it, description below that, all inside the column width
- Minimal shadows: only the base slab casts one
- No connectors; spacing and order carry the sequence

## Typography

- Family typography; step names small caps in the item colour, descriptions light charcoal, title two-tone at top-centre

## Composition rules

- Landscape: three to five pedestals in one row, equal spacing, 60 percent of canvas width
- Square: two by two grid of pedestals
- Comparison use: two pedestals side by side with contrasting colours, attributes listed in the fade
- Keep 30 percent of the canvas empty; this style depends on air

## Layout

### Structure

- Three to five pedestals in one row, equal spacing
- Each pedestal: thick isometric base slab plus a glass gradient column above
- White 3D numeral lying on the pedestal top
- Icon, name and description stacked inside the column width
- No connectors; spacing and order carry the sequence

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Pedestal row** | Short step sequences | Equal heights, one colour per pedestal |
| **Rising heights** | Tiers, maturity levels | Pedestals grow left to right |
| **Comparison pair** | A vs B | Two wide pedestals, attributes listed in the fade |

### Visual Elements

- Base slab 8 to 10 percent thick, casts the only shadow
- Column fades from solid at the base to transparent at about 60 percent height
- Numeral white with a soft grey side face, rotated to the isometric angle
- Pale backdrop, no map or grid
- 30 percent of the canvas left empty

### Text Placement

- Title at top-centre
- Header on the front face of each base slab
- Points stacked inside the fade, one line each, small square bullets
- Dimension or stat on the base slab top face
- Square canvas: two by two grid of pedestals
